aka.zh: 丹佛—博尔德收费公路（丹佛至博尔德）

aka.en: Pony Express Highway (Washington, Kansas, to St. Joseph)
aka.zh: 驿马快信公路（堪萨斯州华盛顿至圣约瑟夫）

tagline.en: A plains road from Rocky Mountain National Park to eastern Ohio, with a toll road that paid for itself and a managed-lane freeway built with private money
tagline.zh: 一条自落基山国家公园通往俄亥俄东部的平原公路，沿线有一条早早还清债务的收费公路，以及一条借助私人资本建成的管理车道高速公路

start.en: US 34 at Deer Ridge Junction in Rocky Mountain National Park, Colorado
start.zh: 科罗拉多州落基山国家公园内的鹿岭交会处，与 US 34 相接

end.zh: 俄亥俄州尤里克斯维尔，与 US 250 相接

en: US 36 starts inside Rocky Mountain National Park, drops through Estes Park and Lyons to Boulder, and runs as a freeway to Denver. East of Denver it shares I-270 and I-70 unsigned as far as Byers, then becomes a lightly travelled two-lane road across the Colorado plains. In Kansas it passes through all 13 counties on the Nebraska border, mostly as a two-lane road; from Washington, Kansas, to St. Joseph it is the Pony Express Highway, marking the start of the 1860 mail route.

Missouri has made it a four-lane expressway across the north of the state through St. Joseph, Cameron, Chillicothe, Macon and Hannibal, part of the main road between Kansas City and Chicago. It crosses the Mississippi on the Mark Twain Memorial Bridge, shares I-72 to Springfield and Decatur, and continues through Tuscola into Indiana, where it circles Indianapolis on I-465 and leaves on Pendleton Pike. In Ohio it is an almost entirely rural road of 204.88 miles, only 6.01 of them freeway, through Urbana, Marysville, Delaware, Mount Vernon and Coshocton to Uhrichsville.
zh: US 36 起于落基山国家公园内部，经埃斯蒂斯帕克与莱昂斯下到博尔德，再以高速公路形式通往丹佛。丹佛以东，它在不设标志的情况下与 I-270 及 I-70 共线至拜尔斯，然后成为一条车流稀少的双车道公路，横穿科罗拉多平原。在堪萨斯，它经过与内布拉斯加接壤的全部 13 个县，大多为双车道；自堪萨斯州华盛顿至圣约瑟夫一段称为驿马快信公路，标示着 1860 年那条邮路的起始段。

密苏里已把它修成横贯该州北部的四车道快速路，经圣约瑟夫、卡梅伦、奇利科西、梅肯与汉尼拔，是堪萨斯城至芝加哥的主干道的一部分。它经马克·吐温纪念大桥跨越密西西比河，与 I-72 共线至斯普林菲尔德与迪凯特，再经塔斯科拉进入印第安纳；在那里它沿 I-465 绕行印第安纳波利斯，经彭德尔顿公路离城。在俄亥俄，它全长 204.88 英里，几乎全为乡间道路，只有 6.01 英里属于高速公路，经厄巴纳、玛丽斯维尔、特拉华、芒特弗农与科肖克顿抵达尤里克斯维尔。

en: The ends have moved many times. According to US Ends, the US 36 of 1926 ran from Indianapolis to near Colby, Kansas; it was extended west to Byers, Colorado, in 1928, east to Cadiz, Ohio, in 1931 and on to Strasburg in 1933, west to Denver in 1937 and to Estes Park in 1967. In 1974 AASHTO approved cutting the eastern end back to Uhrichsville, removing its overlap with US 250. Colorado's request to extend it to Deer Ridge Junction was at first refused; US Ends dates the approval to 1977 on one page and 1978 on another.
Between Boulder and Denver the route uses the Denver–Boulder Turnpike, a toll road financed by $6.3 million of bonds authorised in July 1950 and opened in January 1952.
zh: 这条路的两端曾多次移动。据 US Ends 记载，1926 年的 US 36 自印第安纳波利斯通到堪萨斯州科尔比附近；1928 年西延至科罗拉多州拜尔斯，1931 年东延至俄亥俄州卡迪兹，1933 年再至斯特拉斯堡，1937 年西延至丹佛，1967 年至埃斯蒂斯帕克。1974 年，AASHTO 批准把东端缩回尤里克斯维尔，取消它与 US 250 的共线。科罗拉多请求把它延伸至鹿岭交会处，起初遭到拒绝；US Ends 在一处页面把获批年份记为 1977 年，在另一处记为 1978 年。
博尔德至丹佛之间，路线使用丹佛—博尔德收费公路。这条收费公路以 1950 年 7 月获批发行的 630 万美元债券筹资修建，于 1952 年 1 月通车。

en: The turnpike is remembered as a toll road that paid off early. According to a self-published history of the road, it charged 25 cents, or 10 cents to Broomfield, carried 13,774 vehicles a day in 1966 against a forecast of 3,170, and became free on 14 September 1967 once its bonds were repaid, well ahead of schedule.

Half a century later the same corridor was rebuilt as the US 36 Express Lanes for about $511 million. Phase 1, a $306 million design-build contract, was paid for by regional transit sales taxes ($112 million), federal money including a TIGER grant ($51.4 million), CDOT ($41.4 million), local governments ($5.5 million), Build America Bonds issued by the Colorado Bridge Enterprise ($41.5 million) and a TIFIA loan ($54 million). Phase 2, worth $205 million, was let in 2013 as a 50-year design-build-finance-operate-maintain concession to Plenary Roads Denver, which reached financial close in February 2014; the whole corridor was in full operation in 2016.
zh: 这条收费公路以提前还清债务而为人所记。据一份自行发布的道路史料，它收费 25 美分，至布鲁姆菲尔德 10 美分；1966 年交通量为每日 13,774 辆，而当初的预测只有 3,170 辆；债券还清后，它于 1967 年 9 月 14 日免费通行，远早于原定期限。

半个世纪后，同一走廊以约 5.11 亿美元改建为 US 36 快速车道。第一期为 3.06 亿美元的设计—施工合同，资金来自区域公交销售税（1.12 亿美元）、含 TIGER 补助在内的联邦资金（5,140 万美元）、科罗拉多州交通部（4,140 万美元）、地方政府（550 万美元）、科罗拉多桥梁企业发行的“建设美国债券”（4,150 万美元）以及一笔 TIFIA 贷款（5,400 万美元）。第二期价值 2.05 亿美元，于 2013 年以 50 年期设计—施工—融资—运营—维护特许经营的方式授予 Plenary Roads Denver，2014 年 2 月完成融资交割；整条走廊于 2016 年全面运营。

why.en: No route-wide figure exists. US 36 was numbered over existing roads from 1926 onward and has been rebuilt piecemeal by six states; only works such as the Denver–Boulder Turnpike and the US 36 Express Lanes carry their own costs.
why.zh: 没有全线造价。US 36 自 1926 年起沿既有道路编号，此后由六个州分段改建；只有丹佛—博尔德收费公路与 US 36 快速车道等工程留有各自的造价。

why.en: There is no single funder. Each state pays for its sections; the Denver–Boulder corridor has been financed twice by tolls, first by turnpike bonds and later through the Express Lanes concession.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。各州负担各自路段；丹佛—博尔德走廊两度以通行费融资，先是收费公路债券，后是快速车道特许经营。

label.zh: 丹佛—博尔德收费公路债券

value.zh: 630 万美元，1950 年 7 月获批

figures.source: Historical marker on the turnpike, transcribed by the Historical Marker Database (hmdb.org)

label.zh: 收费公路还款与交通量

value.en: Reported as $6.3 million principal plus about $2.36 million interest repaid by 1967, with 13,774 vehicles a day in 1966 against a forecast of 3,170; from a self-published history, not checked against CDOT or bond records
value.zh: 据报至 1967 年已偿还本金 630 万美元及利息约 236 万美元；1966 年交通量每日 13,774 辆，而预测为 3,170 辆；出自一份自行发布的史料，未与科罗拉多州交通部或债券档案核对

value.en: About $511 million in total: Phase 1 $306 million, Phase 2 $205 million
value.zh: 总计约 5.11 亿美元：第一期 3.06 亿美元，第二期 2.05 亿美元

figures.source: USDOT Build America Bureau, US 36 Express Lanes project profile

why.en: English Wikipedia gives about 1,414 miles but cites no source, and no complete set of state route-log figures was found; only Ohio's 204.88 miles is sourced, to ODOT's road inventory as cited in English Wikipedia.
why.zh: 英文维基百科给出约 1,414 英里，但未注出处；也未找到完整的各州路线里程表数据，只有俄亥俄的 204.88 英里有出处——英文维基百科引用的俄亥俄州交通部道路清单。

timeline.en: US 36 is numbered from Indianapolis to near Colby, Kansas.
timeline.zh: US 36 编定，自印第安纳波利斯至堪萨斯州科尔比附近。

timeline.en: It is extended west to Byers, Colorado.
timeline.zh: 西延至科罗拉多州拜尔斯。

timeline.en: The eastern end reaches Strasburg, Ohio, after an extension to Cadiz in 1931.
timeline.zh: 继 1931 年延伸至卡迪兹后，东端到达俄亥俄州斯特拉斯堡。

timeline.en: The western end is extended to Denver.
The Denver–Boulder Turnpike opens in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，丹佛—博尔德收费公路通车。

timeline.en: The turnpike becomes free on 14 September, and US 36 is extended to Estes Park.
timeline.zh: 9 月 14 日收费公路免费通行；US 36 延伸至埃斯蒂斯帕克。

timeline.en: AASHTO approves cutting the eastern end back to Uhrichsville.
timeline.zh: AASHTO 批准把东端缩回尤里克斯维尔。

timeline.en: The extension to Deer Ridge Junction is approved, by US Ends' main account; another US Ends page gives 1978.
timeline.zh: 据 US Ends 的主要记述，延伸至鹿岭交会处获批；US Ends 另一页面记为 1978 年。

timeline.en: Plenary Roads Denver reaches financial close on Phase 2 of the US 36 Express Lanes in February.
timeline.zh: 2 月，Plenary Roads Denver 完成 US 36 快速车道第二期的融资交割。

timeline.en: The US 36 Express Lanes are in full operation from Denver to Boulder.
timeline.zh: US 36 快速车道丹佛至博尔德段全面运营。
